capabilityVerdict.question: did the ADR 0016 repair do what it was built to do?
capabilityVerdict.theCapabilityLimitIsCLOSED: the question v6 could not ask has been asked and answered. A future occurrence of this redirect shape will be continued rather than refused
capabilityVerdict.andThoseAreDIFFERENTFINDINGS: a repair is validated by whether it performs the act it authorises, not by whether that act happens to yield pages on the first origin it meets. Conflating the two would make every capability's worth hostage to one institution's server configuration

originVerdict.finding: THE ORIGIN IS IN A TWO-URL SITE-POLICY REDIRECT LOOP
originVerdict.wouldFiveHopsHaveHelped: NO. RFC 9309 s2.3.1.2 permits assuming unavailability beyond five consecutive redirects, and a period-2 loop reaches the same two URLs however many hops are allowed. The verdict is unavailable either way
originVerdict.wouldAVisitedUrlSetHaveHelped: it would detect the cycle one hop earlier and reach the SAME verdict. It changes nothing about this outcome
originVerdict.isThisTheInstitutionsFault: it is a fact about the origin's configuration, recorded without judgement. It is not a transport failure, not a Disallow, and not a statement about the institution's website as a whole
